name: Rune-Inscribed Note
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Gives 40 experience instead of 50, 0.8 times as much. From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, adventurer. I believe she was sent by the shaman trainer Meela. If this note is from Meela, I wouldn't take long in reading it's contents.
narrative.objectives: Read the Rune-Inscribed Note and speak to Meela Dawnstrider in Camp Narache.
narrative.offerRewardText: We will meet many times in the days to come. Each time you will hopefully leave my company a little more powerful... a little more prepared. Like the Eternal Flame, your spirit will burn bright and hot.Go now, adventurer. Go and test yourself. I will be here for you when you need.
narrative.requestItemsText: As quickly as water falls from the sky, here you are before me. I am pleased by your haste. It means you realize both the importance of our meeting and you being here. I am no leader, but I do understand the elements, and I can speak to the spirits of our people. I will teach you to do the same.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests from level 1 to 2, 210 XP in all.

quests.name: The Hunt Begins
quests.objectiveText: Grull Hawkwind in Camp Narache wants you to bring him 7 Plainstrider Feathers and 7 pieces of Plainstrider Meat.
